definitions.explanation: A small beetle with a rounded, dome-shaped body, typically red or orange with black spots. Considered beneficial in gardens as they eat aphids.

examples.english: There was a ladybug in the garden.

examples.japanese: てんとう{虫|むし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{益虫|えきちゅう}→益虫：17787_ekichuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Ladybugs are beneficial insects that eat pests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧てんとう{虫|むし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a ladybug with a red and black pattern.

examples.japanese: てんとう{虫|むし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シンボル→シンボル：10948_shinboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ladybugs are considered a symbol of good luck.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {天道虫|てんとうむし} or {瓢虫|てんとうむし}. Usually written in hiragana as てんとう{虫|むし}.

NAME ORIGIN: ⟦{天道|てんとう}→天道：25216_tentou⟧ refers to the sun or heavens. The name comes from the ladybug's habit of flying toward the sun when placed on a finger.

SPECIES IN JAPAN:
・⟦ナナホシテントウ→ナナホシテントウ：noentry⟧ - seven-spot ladybird (most common)
・⟦ナミテントウ→ナミテントウ：noentry⟧ - Asian ladybeetle
・⟦ニジュウヤホシテントウ→ニジュウヤホシテントウ：noentry⟧ - 28-spotted potato ladybird (plant pest)

ECOLOGICAL ROLE:
・⟦{益虫|えきちゅう}→益虫：17787_ekichuu⟧ - beneficial insect
・⟦アブラムシ→アブラムシ：29729_aburamushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ - eats aphids
・⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧ - pest control

CULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS: Like in Western cultures, ladybugs are associated with good luck in Japan. Finding one is considered a good omen.

RELATED INSECTS:
・⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧ - rhinoceros beetle
・⟦クワガタムシ→クワガタムシ：06562_kuwagatamushi⟧ - stag beetle
・⟦カマキリ→カマキリ：06516_kamakiri⟧ - praying mantis
